description: Instructions for content operations commands that insert, modify, or remove content elements in the document

BibliographyInsert.apply: Insert a bibliography section after the word 'TARGET', using the document's existing citation sources.

BlankPageInsert.apply: Insert a blank page after the word 'TARGET'.

EndnoteInsertWord.apply: Insert an endnote with text 'See reference.' after the word 'TARGET'.

EquationInsertNew.apply: Insert an equation placeholder after the word 'TARGET'.

FootnoteInsert.apply: Insert a footnote with text 'See reference.' after the word 'TARGET'.

HeaderFooterRemoveFooterWord.apply: Remove the footer from the document.

HeaderFooterRemoveHeaderWord.apply: Remove the header from the document.

HorizontalLineInsert.apply: Insert a horizontal line after the word 'TARGET'.

IndexUpdate.apply: Update the index to reflect current document content.

PageBreakInsertWord.apply: Insert a page break after the word 'TARGET' to start a new page.

TableOfContentsRemove.apply: Remove the table of contents from the document.
